title: Fake Merc Character Study (part. 3): The thumb guy, the Alpha wale
summary: Third part of NH's attack on YouTuber 'Fake Merc' (Jason Blaha). He accuses him of raiding videos with sock accounts, censoring commenters, giving incoherent diet advice (GOMAD on keto, 5000 kcal maintenance), building a channel on 'natty or not' name-dropping, contradicting himself on PEDs and training methods, and dodging debates, while defending free speech on his own channel.
claims: He raided my last video with sock accounts; YouTube removes the fake dislikes from one IP but keeps the comments, which boost the video
Like/dislike bots cannot survive on YouTube because it filters them to protect engagement data; dislikes he gets are real people
Banning critics kills a channel because comments signal engagement; he grew most when he briefly let comments be, like Rich Piana did
You cannot do keto and GOMAD: milk has carbs that knock you out of ketosis
Claiming 5000 kcal to maintain at 5'7, 225 lb and about 25% body fat just maintains fat; Michael Phelps' intake reflects hours of swimming, not lifting
Early YouTube fitness creators grew easily for lack of competition and natty-or-not name-drop videos
Many big fitness channels have mostly dead subscribers; 2 million subs with 10k views signals the count is inflated
Claiming PED expertise from heavy cycles creates a catch-22: you must then look like a monster

Switching between Bulgarian, conjugate, minimalist, linear, sumo, conventional and Olympic lifting without explaining them in volume/intensity/frequency terms is not changing your mind, it is chasing a magic fix
Avoiding high-rep squats and deadlifts because they are hard on cardio skips one of the main natural ways to accumulate tonnage
He condemned bench chains as fake strength, then praised them once he used them
I got banned for asking why straps supposedly negate the deadlift; that view only makes sense for raw powerlifting
I will never ban anyone from commenting on my channel, except for doxxing
Fake copyright claims to take down videos are abusive and should get a channel banned
He avoids challenges by demanding absurd fees, like about 100k for a Skype debate with Layne Norton
